title: Volume buttons don't wake it
line: Stops a bump of the volume buttons from waking the Claw in your bag.
symptom: The volume buttons are keys on the i8042 keyboard, which is a wakeup source, so pressing them wakes the Claw from sleep.
why: Every MSI Claw (controller 0db0:1901/1902) puts its volume keys on the i8042 keyboard, which is a wakeup source.
risk_note: One udev rule; the power button still wakes the Claw.

changes.detail: Switches off wake-up for the built-in keyboard port (serio, atkbd) on MSI MS-1T* boards.
Set to disabled at once; the old value is saved.

undo: Deletes the rule and writes the saved value back.
bazzite: Not fixed: Handheld Daemon switched it off at start, InputPlumber (Bazzite 44+) doesn't.
steamos: Not fixed (no Claw support in SteamOS).

probe.what: Looks for the same rule from the system itself (any udev rule that isn't GameCove's and does the same), or the value already being right without GameCove.

watch.note: InputPlumber's udev rules: it may start switching the keyboard wake-up off, as Handheld Daemon did.
Bazzite's handheld udev rules: a Claw wake-up rule would make this os-fixed.
The kernel quirk was refused in 2025-06 in favour of a udev rule; a new attempt would show up here.
